Details & Strategic Impact on ALCM: Incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary of Jupiter International to set up a new 1 GW mono PERC cell facility in Baddi (HP).
Consolidated all Tata Power renewable generation and manufacturing businesses. TP Solar was established as the primary gigawatt-scale cell manufacturing subsidiary.
